term: separate modal worlds and temporal histories with explicit now-slice coherence
definition: History supplies an existing Kant Ontic, an independently assigned IsAt : World → Being → Time → Prop, and a designated now : Time. CoherentAtNow is the separate proposition that Ontic.ExistsAt w x is equivalent to IsAt w x now for all worlds and candidates. It is not a proof field of History. This interprets modal presence at a selected time; it does not redefine presence as existence at some time in a history. Ontic.Causes and the old profile grounds relation remain world-relative primitives, not temporal successor relations.
note: Tiny analyst history extension reusing existing Ontic semantics. World, Being and Time are separate parameters; controls use Bool worlds, old candidate types and Int times with now=0. Explicit coherence is included in each closed control. No global cause/ground bridge, time-indexed causal law or metaphysical possibility follows.
